# SMDR.JK — house coverage rates it BUY

Signal: the South Research division published coverage (v1) with a 12-month target of Rp870.0 against Rp320.0 (expected total return 175.9%). Why now: the rating crossed the BUY band on the engine's probability-weighted target.

Archetype guess: neglected_midcap_discovery · method card: per fund record routing for Logistics, land transport & transport services.

- The 12-month roll-forward is applied at COE 25.01pct, adding Rp170 to the Rp678 blended value, while the DCF producing that value discounts at 12.5pct WACC. Every peer in the same deck rolls at 12-17pct (TMAS 13.6pct, CA
